plan.competence: Demonstrate mastery of the concept of chemistry, its relationships with other disciplines, and its applications.
plan.general_objectives: Explain the concept of chemistry, its scope, and its applications in the development of a modern society.
plan.specific_objectives: By the end of the lesson the student should be able to: a) explain the concept of chemistry; b) state the relationships of chemistry with other related disciplines; c) describe the applications of chemistry in the development of a modern society.
plan.teaching_aids: Detergents, soft drinks, fertilizers, medicines, plastics, cement, textbook, branch/interdisciplinary charts
plan.remarks: The students who did not understand the lesson well will be in the remedial class. Otherwise I will proceed with the topic.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students in relating chemistry with the science they studied in Primary school.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to brainstorm on the meaning of chemistry.
teaching_structure.assessment: Can the student define the term chemistry?

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students in groups to come up with the meaning of chemistry and identify materials made from knowledge of chemistry in their areas.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students in groups identify items made from chemistry knowledge and explain how they relate to other disciplines.
teaching_structure.assessment: Can the student identify items made from chemistry knowledge and its applications?

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to discuss the relationship of chemistry with other related disciplines.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to present their findings in a plenary session.
teaching_structure.assessment: Can the students relate chemistry to other disciplines?

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to discuss the applications of chemistry in modern society.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to answer questions asked by the teacher.
teaching_structure.assessment: Can the student answer questions asked by the teacher?

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to write important points on the lesson.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to copy lesson summary in their note books.
teaching_structure.assessment: Can the student answer examination questions from the lesson?

plan.competence: Demonstrate mastery of laboratory safety measures, first aid, and basic laboratory apparatus.
plan.general_objectives: Carry out Chemistry activities safely and efficiently.
plan.specific_objectives: By the end of the lesson the learner should be able to: a) explain laboratory safety measures; b) apply first aid procedures; c) identify basic chemistry laboratory apparatus.
plan.teaching_aids: Wall charts showing safety measures, laboratory apparatus, first aid kit
plan.remarks: The students who did not understand the lesson well will be in the remedial class. Otherwise I will proceed with the topic.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Make a brief introduction about the meaning of laboratory and safety measures.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to brainstorm on the meaning of laboratory and safety.
teaching_structure.assessment: Is the student able to state laboratory safety measures?

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to discuss laboratory safety measures, first aid, and basic laboratory apparatus.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to prepare a list of safety rules and identify basic apparatus and first aid kit contents.
teaching_structure.assessment: Is the student able to state laboratory rules and identify apparatus?

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to role play laboratory safety measures and first aid procedures.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students in groups to role play the safety measures and first aid procedures.
teaching_structure.assessment: Is the student able to apply first aid procedures?

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Using questions and answers help students to summarize concepts taught.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to answer questions correctly and seek clarification.
teaching_structure.assessment: Is the student able to explain the safety measures needed to avoid accidents?

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide the students to summarize the main ideas from the lesson taught.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to write a summary of the topic well.
teaching_structure.assessment: Is the student able to explain laboratory safety and first aid?

plan.competence: Demonstrate mastery of fire, flames, and firefighting methods and equipment.
plan.general_objectives: Explain the concept of fire, types of flames, and firefighting methods and equipment.
plan.specific_objectives: By the end of the lesson, the student should be able to: a) explain the concept and conditions for fire; b) explain the concept and types of flames; c) describe firefighting methods, equipment, and prevention.
plan.teaching_aids: Fire triangle chart, Bunsen burner, flame structure diagram, fire extinguisher samples
plan.remarks: The students who did not understand the lesson well will be in the remedial class. Otherwise I will proceed with the topic.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to brainstorm on the concept of fire and its conditions.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to brainstorm on the concept of fire and the fire triangle.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Explain the concept of fire, types of flames, and firefighting methods and equipment.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to observe the Bunsen burner flame and identify firefighting equipment.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to describe zones of a flame and firefighting methods.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students in groups to describe flame zones and firefighting methods.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to discuss fire prevention measures.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to answer questions and discuss fire prevention.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: To write short summarized notes and assign homework.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to copy notes and work on the assignment.

plan.competence: Demonstrate mastery of the states of matter and physical and chemical changes.
plan.general_objectives: Explain the states of matter and distinguish physical from chemical changes.
plan.specific_objectives: By the end of the lesson, the student should be able to: a) explain the states of matter; b) distinguish between physical and chemical changes.
plan.teaching_aids: Solids, liquids, gases, comparison chart, samples for physical and chemical change demonstrations
plan.remarks: The students who did not understand the lesson well will be in the remedial class. Otherwise I will proceed with the topic.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to brainstorm on the meaning of matter.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to brainstorm on the meaning of matter.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to explain the states of matter and their properties.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to observe samples and describe the states of matter.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to distinguish physical and chemical changes.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students in groups to compare physical and chemical changes.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Using questions and answers help students to summarize concepts taught.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to individually answer questions asked by the teacher.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: To write short summarized notes and assign homework.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to copy notes and work on the assignment.

plan.competence: Demonstrate mastery of elements, compounds, mixtures, and methods of separating mixtures.
plan.general_objectives: Explain elements, compounds, and mixtures and apply methods of separating mixtures.
plan.specific_objectives: By the end of the lesson, the student should be able to: a) explain elements and chemical symbols; b) explain compounds and mixtures; c) describe and apply methods of separating mixtures.
plan.teaching_aids: Samples of elements, periodic table, sand, salt, water, filter paper, magnet
plan.remarks: The students who did not understand the lesson well will be in the remedial class. Otherwise I will proceed with the topic.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to brainstorm on the meaning of elements.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to brainstorm on the meaning of elements and chemical symbols.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Explain elements, chemical symbols, compounds, and mixtures and demonstrate separation of mixtures.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to observe samples and perform separation of mixtures (filtration, evaporation, magnetic separation).

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to compare compounds and mixtures.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students in groups to compare compounds and mixtures using a T-chart.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to select appropriate methods for separating given mixtures.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to individually answer questions asked by the teacher.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: To write short summarized notes and assign homework.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to copy notes and work on the assignment.
